Introducing Easy Window Navigation Plugin!
​
Enhance player navigation in your RPG Maker MZ game with DM_EasyWindowNavigation! This plugin allows players to seamlessly navigate between windows using mouse hover and keyboard directional keys, creating a more intuitive and immersive experience. With this streamlined navigation system, your game will stand out from others built with RPG Maker, providing a more polished and engaging experience for your players.
Features
​
Effortless Window Navigation
: Seamlessly navigate between windows using mouse hover and keyboard directional keys.
Intuitive Controls
: Easily switch between windows without needing to click or manually select each window.
Optimized Skill Scene Layout:
The skill scene window layout has been redesigned to provide a cohesive and streamlined experience in conjunction with the plugin's navigation features.

Easy Window Navigation Update: V1.02!
I've just released version 1.02 of the Easy Window Navigation plugin, which includes a new bug fix, as well as two previous fixes that were included in version 1.01 but not announced, as I hadn't had a chance to notify you about them previously. I've compiled them all into this update notification to get you up to speed.
Bug Fixes:
Resolved an issue where pressing the up direction was disabled while selecting a skill in the battle skill window.
Fixed compatibility issues with the Arthran Sell Shop plugin, ensuring proper cancellation and exit behavior from the category window.
Resolved a compatibility issue with the Arthran Sell Shop and VisuStella Items & Equips Core plugins, ensuring the status window is hidden only when necessary in sell shop mode.
Spoiler:
Changelog
These bug fixes bring improved stability and compatibility to the Easy Window Navigation plugin. Re-download the plugin now to take advantage of these updates. Happy game developing!

Easy Window Navigation [Pro] Update: V1.04!
I've just released version 1.04 of the Easy Window Navigation plugin, featuring two key bug fixes that improve shop scene behavior and overall plugin stability.
Bug Fixes:
Fixed a scroll disabling issue in the Shop Sell window caused by a missing return statement in the overridden isScrollEnabled method.
Fixed an Arthran Sell Shop returned undefined crash due to the plugin not being ON and activated.

Easy Window Navigation [Pro] Update: V1.05!
Version 1.05 of Easy Window Navigation is now available, addressing a small oversight in the compatibility patch for CGMZ Crafting (Casper Gaming). This fix ensures that crafting windows behave correctly when EWN is active and that the original CGMZ crafting logic receives the proper arguments.
Bug Fixes:
Corrected an aliasing issue in the CGMZ_Recipe.doCraft override where .call(this, arguments) passed the entire arguments object incorrectly. This has been updated to .apply(this, arguments) to ensure proper argument forwarding and maintain full compatibility with CGMZ Crafting.
Spoiler:
Changelog
This update improves the reliability of crafting interactions when using Easy Window Navigation alongside CGMZ Crafting. Re‑download the plugin to apply the fix. Happy game developing!
Link to plugin page.

posts.author: Dungeonmind

Easy Window Navigation [Basic] Update: V1.03 &
Easy Window Navigation [Pro] Update: V1.06
!
Versions 1.03 [Basic] and 1.06 [Pro] of the Easy Window Navigation plugin are now available, addressing a help window display issue in the vanilla shop scene that occurred when using keyboard directional keys to hop between windows.
Bug Fixes:
Fixed an issue in the default shop scene where the help window would display buy window help data by default when using EWN’s keyboard window navigation. Due to index 0 being selected automatically, using directional keys to jump to the sell window first caused the help window to malfunction and flicker between the item selected in the sell window and the item selected in the buy window. The selection logic has been corrected to ensure the help window displays the proper item data for the active window.
Spoiler:
Changelog
This update improves the reliability of keyboard-driven shop interactions in the vanilla shop scene when using Easy Window Navigation. To apply the fix, download the new copy of the plugin and replace the old plugin file in your project's js/plugins folder. Happy game developing!
Link to plugin page.

posts.author: Dungeonmind

Easy Window Navigation [Basic] Update: V1.04 &
Easy Window Navigation [Pro] Update: V1.07
!
Versions 1.04 and 1.07 of the Easy Window Navigation plugin are now available, addressing a menu freeze that occurred when selling the last item, armor, or weapon in the vanilla shop scene while using keyboard navigation.
Bug Fixes:
Fixed an issue in the default shop scene where selling your last item, armor, or weapon would cause the menu to freeze, locking keyboard and gamepad input. When the inventory count hit zero after a sale, the window navigation logic attempted to refresh on a null selection, resulting in an unresponsive shop. The selection handling has been corrected to safely exit and update windows when the active category becomes empty.
Spoiler:
Changelog
This update improves the reliability of keyboard-driven shop interactions in the vanilla shop scene when using Easy Window Navigation. To apply the fix, download the new copy of the plugin and replace the old plugin file in your project's js/plugins folder. Happy game developing!
Link to plugin page.
